title: How an Operator's Advice Bears on the Withholding Against a Cancelled Package
content:
An advice the operator has issued about a packaged itinerary bears on how much of what stands withheld against a cancelled package of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products reduces what is returned. An advice given because a supplier within the package cancelled is a significant change; an advice given because one component of the itinerary was substituted for another is not.

**A significant change advised.** Where the package ledger carries an operator advice of a significant change to the itinerary — 1 or more of them — nothing of what stands withheld reduces what is returned, the operator's own change having caused the cancellation.

**An ordinary advice inside the advice window.** Where the package ledger carries no operator advice of a significant change to the itinerary but does carry an operator advice about the itinerary that is not a significant change, issued within the advice window before the party confirmed the cancellation, one half of what stands withheld reduces what is returned — 50 per cent of it. The advice window is 90 calendar days, and the advice counted is the latest such advice standing on the ledger; where the latest of them was issued more than 90 days before the party confirmed the cancellation, this clause does not answer.

**Otherwise.** Where the package ledger carries no operator advice of either kind, what stands withheld is not reduced under this note.

## Both sides of the window

An ordinary advice issued exactly 90 days before the day the party confirmed the cancellation is within the advice window, and one half of what stands withheld reduces what is returned. An advice issued 91 days before that day is outside it.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

Where 1,020.00 USD stands withheld against a cancelled package and its ledger carries an advice given because a supplier within the package cancelled, nothing of the 1,020.00 USD reduces what is returned. Where the ledger instead carries only an advice given because one component was substituted for another, issued 30 days before the party confirmed the cancellation, 510.00 USD of the withholding reduces what is returned. Where the ledger carries no advice at all, the withholding is not reduced here.
